resolution_notes: base_url: KEEP original https://sonarcloud.io/api. Official SonarQube Cloud Web API docs (https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-cloud/appendices/web-api) sample V1 calls as https://sonarcloud.io/api/... (e.g. /api/measures/component); live probe of /api/system/status returned {"status":"UP"}. V2 host https://api.sonarcloud.io exists but does not replace V1 base for the endpoints this entry describes. Verifier B’s “incorrect” note still concedes the live host is sonarcloud.io/api. docs_url: KEEP original https://sonarcloud.io/web_api. Same official page states V1 services are documented at https://sonarcloud.io/web_api (HTTP 200). Narrative guide is https://docs.sonarsource.com/sonarqube-cloud/appendices/web-api; Verifier B’s advanced-setup/web-api path only 307-redirects there and is not the canonical URL.
